idea-plugin.name: Perforce Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Associate your IDE project with Perforce (p4 / Helix Core) through the built-in version control. It connects, and it does not freeze.

  • Connect-and-explain: a diagnosis that runs p4 exactly like the plugin does and names the first failing step — missing executable, unreachable server, unknown or host-locked client, not logged in, a P4CONFIG file p4 never reads.
  • Native Local Changes, Commit and Rollback, fed by p4 opened — a constant number of p4 calls, never a directory scan, never one call per file.
  • Auto-checkout: typing into a read-only file runs p4 edit.
  • Pending and submitted changelists, submit, shelve, revert, diff, annotate, reconcile, sync with auto-merge, conflict resolution, streams and ignore rules.

Requires the p4 command-line client. Replaces JetBrains' bundled Perforce plugin, which must be disabled (the IDE offers to do it).
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.4.0: the VCS integration verified against a live Helix Core server — real #have diffs, commit of exactly the selected files with your message, Rollback restores depot content, auto-checkout, file names with @ # % *.
